claims.content: Change the system operating mode.
Operator
The Operator must be logged onto the system.
Only one 'operator' may be logged onto the system at any given time.
An authorized operator requests to change the system mode via the GUI.

trigger.raw_text: An authorized operator requests to change the system mode via the GUI.

claims.content: The GUI shall provide a screen for authorized users to change system mode.
Only one 'operator' may be logged onto the system at any given time.
The Operator is authorized to change system mode.
If the Operator is not authorized to change system mode, the system shall deny the request.
If another 'operator' is already logged onto the system, the system shall prevent concurrent login and deny the mode change request.
If a device fails to report completion of the current sequence step within the response time window allotted for the step, the opening or closing sequence shall be halted.

If the status of a closure device, which was previously opened at the current entrance, changes to 'unknown' or 'closed' without an operator-initiated command, the opening or closing sequence shall be halted.

If the status of a closure device, which was previously closed at the current entrance, changes to 'unknown' or 'open' without an operator-initiated command, the opening or closing sequence shall be halted.
At any point in an opening sequence, if the status of a closure device for the opposite direction of travel changes to 'unknown' or 'open', the sequence shall be halted.
Each device control command shall abort if any closure control device status is unknown.

Each command (at the device sensor command, device command(macro), or system operational command (super macro) level) shall only be executed when a valid or good status exists for all device sensors; otherwise, execution is denied.
The system operating mode has been changed to the requested mode.
Only one 'operator' remains logged onto the system at any given time.
